sentences: My side project is a tool that turns screenshots into tidy tables.
For a year it made almost nothing, and I nearly shut it down.
Then a single integration changed everything.
Revenue went from $300 a month to $4,500 a month in one summer.
The lesson is to talk to the people who already pay you.
